symptom: `run --local --watch` on Mendix 11.16.0 took 20-22 s to apply a microflow edit and 25-28 s, with a runtime restart that drops every browser session, to apply a page edit. Every change logged "mxbuild --serve's incremental build left web/dist without dist/pages ... restarting mxbuild --serve for a full build" or "mxbuild --serve cannot build this change incrementally (it wants client source its first build does not leave behind)".
cause: A build in an mxbuild --serve process writes the client source its bundler reads (web/pages, layouts, nanoflows, snippets, widgets, package.json) and deletes it when the build ends. The next build regenerates only the changed documents, so the bundler has almost no input: dist/ goes from 47 files to 4, or the build fails on a missing web/pages file. serveRecovery answered both with a fresh serve process and a cold build per change, and the cold build's restartRequired restarts the runtime.
file: cmd/mxcli/docker/client_source_keep.go (clientSourceKeep: watch, restore, missingPageSource), cmd/mxcli/docker/serve_recovery.go (buildKeeping, isBundleFailure), cmd/mxcli/docker/runlocal.go (the boot build is watched too)
insight: The earlier measurement that ruled this out (webclient_legacy_paths.go, 11.14) put back the bundler config and the empty directories, not the files in them, and concluded that nothing done to the deployment helps. What settled it was copying web/ every 50 ms during a cold build and diffing the copy against web/ afterwards: 75 files existed only mid-build. Putting them back before the next /build made it complete in 2.3 s with restartRequired false. Control: that bundle against a cold build of the same model on a fresh process has the same file set and differs only in the build timestamp on each import. Keep what a successful build deleted rather than a list of directory names, so a version that leaves its source in place keeps nothing; and check dist/pages against the kept source after every build, because a missed file is bundled this time and silently absent the next. A measurement taken through a project's own ./mxcli tests the binary that link points at: `make build` replaces bin/mxcli with a new inode and leaves the hardlink on the old one, which produced one full run of 'the fix does nothing'.
